title: BucketsInDispensersMilkCows
description: makes buckets in dispensers milk cows. Also works with glass bottles if using FarmersDelight and RightClickToMilk.
body: This mod makes buckets in dispensers milk cows if a cow is in front of it. It also works with glass bottles if using FarmersDelight and RightClickToMilk. There is a 10 second cooldown on the milking mechanic.
